hypothesis: A decision-time volume/flow confirmation filter may improve the admitted 30-day long/cash TSMOM by suppressing low-conviction signals without adding shorts or extra positions.

primary_evidence.source: Fičura (2023), Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum
primary_evidence.finding: Large/liquid crypto assets showed weekly momentum while small/illiquid assets showed reversal; this motivates liquidity/volume-aware screening.

primary_evidence.source: Huang (2024), Cryptocurrency Volume-Weighted Time Series Momentum
primary_evidence.finding: Reports evidence for volume-weighted cryptocurrency TSMOM; used only as mechanism justification, not as proof for this exact constrained implementation.

preregistered_rules.signal: Use only completed candles; baseline 30-day long/cash TSMOM signal; permit long only when rolling 7-day dollar-volume percentile is at least 50th percentile and up-volume share over the prior 20 completed candles is at least 55%.
preregistered_rules.execution: Next-open fill; one open position maximum; DCA=0; pessimistic intrabar ordering; adverse gap handling.
preregistered_rules.validation: development segment, chronological validation folds, cost stress, one sealed final only after all admission gates pass; no exhaustive tuning

data_window: Not executed: reproducible public OHLCV plus decision-time volume/flow data for the exact universe and matched dates was not available in the repository evidence set during this run.
rejection_or_admission_reason: Rejected as untestable in this iteration. No synthetic or coarse substitute data was used; sealed final remained unopened. This is a data-integrity block, not a profitability result.
next_distinct_queue_item: Investigate basis/funding dislocation or another structurally distinct mechanism only when exact public decision-time data and current minimum filters can be reproduced.
